scope: World placement starts with no opaque GUI; player camera and movement remain available.
Mouse confirmation, rotation, mirroring, height and distance; fixed position survives camera movement; cancel restores placement.
Framebuffer checks on grass and through an occluding wall; native AE2S models and multipart material resolution.
Ordinary guide/editor and optional media/quest/Revo regression.
limitations: Linux llvmpipe rendering, not every hardware, shader or modpack combination.
Projection never places blocks; inputs are consumed only during placement or when grabbing a projection.
Media video fixture uses external Linux VLC; no audio acceptance.
